segments.he: וְשֶׁיְּהוּ מְכַבְּסִין בַּחֲמִישִׁי בַּשַּׁבָּת – מִשּׁוּם כְּבוֹד שַׁבָּת.
segments.en: The baraita teaches: «And that one should do laundry on Thursday.» This was instituted «due to» the need to have clean garments in «deference to Shabbat.»
